description:
Peaceful Music | Soothing Music with Veena | 1 Hour

The Veena is the oldest stringed instrument India ever made — and the slowest. It does not hurry. It cannot. The strings are too long, the resonance too deep, the silences between notes too necessary. Tonight, that is exactly the point.

This is a slow, soothing hour built around the Veena and Raga Yaman — the great evening raga of Indian classical music, traditionally sung at the meeting hour between day and night, when the mind is finally allowed to settle. Layered with 432Hz tuning and a gentle 6Hz Theta carrier, it's designed for one thing: a deep, undefended peace.

🌿 What you'll hear:
• Veena solo in Raga Yaman (the great evening healing raga)
• Tanpura drone background (steady tonal anchor)
• 432Hz tuning · 6Hz Theta wave entrainment

🌿 Chapters:
00:00 — Settle in (alap)
15:00 — Open the slow space
30:00 — Sustained holding
45:00 — Soft return

🌿 How to use:
Evenings · before sleep · after a long day · when the mind keeps replaying things · while reading · during a quiet meal

🌿 Best for:
Calming an active mind · pre-sleep wind-down · reading and journaling · post-work decompression · meditation practice

If the room got a little quieter — subscribe. Slow music for the long evenings.
